purpose: Inputs for three worked decisions: a published comparison, an intended prediction with an illustrative tolerance, the uncertainty the source reports, what the controls attribute, and the next test. Tolerances are illustrative choices of this review and not source facts.

cases.source: Dupuy et al., Data-Centric Engineering 4, e7 (2023), Fig. 16 and Sec. 4.2.3; readings in data/revision/displayed_comparisons.json (readings.Dupuy2023.digitised)
cases.quantity: mean reattachment location x_r/h_s (downstream zero of mean streamwise wall shear)
cases.reference_kind: wall-resolved LES of the same study (numerical benchmark)
cases.uncertainty_reported: none for the crossing: no sampling interval, no discretisation estimate and no uncertainty of the benchmark
cases.controls: same mesh, inlet and outer closure; the wall treatment changes on the wall downstream of the step
cases.attribution: the 0.5 h_s shift belongs to the change of wall treatment in the coupled calculation; the remaining 0.8 h_s is not attributed

cases.source: Rezaeiravesh, Mukha and Liefvendahl, arXiv:1810.05213v2, Tables 1 and 2; data/revision/channel_scheme_table.json
cases.quantity: friction velocity and outer mean velocity (maximum discrepancy over 0.2 <= y/delta <= 1, their Eq. 10) at fixed bulk flow
cases.uncertainty_reported: errors printed to 0.01 %; no sampling interval and no discretisation estimate for the printed errors
cases.controls: same grid (28 cells per half-height), bulk flow, convection scheme and subgrid closure within each pair; Spalding's law sampled at h/delta = 0.125 against no wall model
cases.attribution: each change belongs to adding the wall law under that scheme and closure; the two schemes give opposite signs for the outer velocity

cases.source: Zhou and Bae, arXiv:2305.02540v3, Figs 10(c) and 12(c); data/revision/measurements/P31_Fig12c_DSM.csv and results/revision/direction_resolution.json (bump_station_velocity)
cases.quantity: skin friction and mean streamwise velocity profile at x/L = -0.4, fine mesh, dynamic Smagorinsky closure
cases.reference_kind: experiment (oil-film interferometry for friction, particle-image velocimetry for velocity)

friction_times_1000.location: Fig. 10(c); experimental value interpolated linearly between the measured stations at x/L of about -0.420 and -0.349 (data/revision/additional_comparisons.json, pair P31-bump)

uncertainty_reported.friction_passage: the overall bias error in mean skin friction values is taken to be within 2%
uncertainty_reported.friction_location: Gray (2023), doctoral thesis, Appendix G.3, printed p. 250 (PDF p. 278); also Sec. 2.4.4
uncertainty_reported.velocity_note: the particle-image uncertainty covers random error only (Sec. 2.4.5, Appendix G.4)
uncertainty_reported.simulation: statistics over 1.5 flow-through times; no sampling interval and no discretisation estimate

cases.controls: same fine mesh, solver, subgrid closure and inlet; the two wall treatments differ in law, inputs, sampling location and imposition
cases.attribution: the differences belong to the change of the complete wall treatment; the velocity difference arises below y/L of about 0.016
